question_text: A 14-year-old boy presents with his mother complaining of a swollen, red, painful left knee. His physician aspirates the joint and discovers frank blood. The patient denies a recent history of trauma to the knee. Upon further discussion, the mother describes that her son has had multiple swollen painful joints before, often without evidence of trauma. She also mentions a history of frequent nosebleeds and gum bleeding following visits to the dentist. Which of the following is the most likely underlying diagnosis?
